Bull: exchange flows, the cycle clock, the regression position, the 200-day average, the 50/200 cross, the support band. Bear: the drawdown, stablecoin supply, section 6 positioning, the 50-week average. Resets still missing: Puell multiple, MVRV, weekly RSI, monthly RSI, the one-year return, Pi Cycle. Clock: 874 days since the halving, 38% below the high of 6 Oct.
